caption: The drawing depicts a square textile sample composed of multiple woven patterns arranged in a grid layout. The textile is primarily colored in shades of red, blue, and a natural off-white or cream. The patterns are geometrically organized with repeating motifs, including stripes, checks, and diamond shapes, all formed through the interlacing of the colored threads. The left and bottom edges of the textile feature a short fringe in the same color palette. The textile sits on a lightly colored, blank background, and the edges are cleanly defined except for the fringed areas. The overall composition emphasizes the varied, structured, and repetitive nature of the weaving patterns.
title: Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
